verdict.rationale: Datalab offers a free-tier 'Forge/Playground' where you can upload a document and see conversion/extraction results without an API key, plus a free monthly usage allowance sized for a full proof-of-concept — effectively letting an AI-native user try workflows before committing production data or credentials. However, this is a trial/demo UI rather than a documented dedicated sandbox environment (e.g., test API keys, staging endpoints, or explicit non-production data isolation). Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging mode with separate credentials, confirmation that Playground/Forge data is isolated from production billing/storage, and independent corroboration of this workflow.
